researchQuestion: What exact arithmetic and clip inputs inside all four add_background_filters_ invocations produce the three nested signed-integer crops and the selected root aggregate, and does the relevant mutation occur inline or across a named deeper helper boundary?

observerOrdinalCorrection.replacementRule: Trace the first source-known exact-depth-four epoch across every same-frame loop and reject each manually crossed +0x3ef0 until x28 equals the independently selected source.
observerOrdinalCorrection.replacementOutcome: falsified by run 31039587304 because equal thread/x19/x29 address values can be reused by successive prepare_layer invocations

frameReuseCorrection.replicatedSelector: At a source-known exact-depth-four zero epoch, require uint64 *(x10+128) and uint64 *(x20-24) to both equal the already independently selected source.

opaqueScopeCorrection.replacementRule: Add the complete 1092-byte apply_dod symbol as a frozen instruction scope. Capture and hash all bytes before selection, step every executed instruction inside it, enter the already frozen GlassBackground DOD scope normally, and continue to fail closed on any other changed opaque boundary.

prospectiveHypothesis.primary: The selected path executes exactly four add_background_filters_ calls. Capturing all four from entry through return, without selecting by output, will expose the exact inputs and arithmetic that produce the first three nested crops and the selected root aggregate.
prospectiveHypothesis.opaqueBoundary: For every deeper opaque callee crossed while an add_background_filters_ invocation is active, exact before/after bytes at that invocation's fixed x5 target distinguish inline arithmetic from a mutation delegated to a named deeper helper.
prospectiveHypothesis.knownTransfer: The existing continuous aggregate state chain and its 12 architectural writer transitions must remain bit-for-bit identical in structure and continue to contain the four known transfer states in order.
prospectiveHypothesis.semanticSeal: Passing opens exact dynamic replay of the four selected-path background-filter crop invocations and their three store/union links. General crop-policy transfer, unseen geometry, shader authority, and parity remain sealed until separately validated.

selection.sourceSelection: Reuse the independent capture_backdrop late selector and its exact object chain.
selection.frameSelection: Accept exact prepare_layer function name and frozen symbol bounds only when the bounded live ancestry has exactly four exact prepare_layer frames and the top SBFrame.GetFP equals x29.
selection.prospectiveSourceLinkRule: Retain exact addresses and eight bytes for both cells at every source-known exact-depth-four zero epoch; stop only at the first epoch where both decoded values equal the independently selected source.
selection.futureIdentity: At +0x3ef0 require x28 to equal the independently selected source while threadID/x19/x29 still equal the stopped epoch identity.
selection.manualMarkerRule: Retain every +0x3ef0 crossed during instruction stepping; continue when threadID/x19/x29 or x28 differs and accept only the first exact identity and independently selected source match.

instrumentation.semanticCropOpaqueBoundary: While a crop invocation is active, every StepOut boundary retains exact before/after x5 target bytes, the invocation index, and a bit-exact mutation flag.
instrumentation.semanticCropStoreLink: For the first three invocations, require caller x19 identity to link uniquely to prepare_layer +0x55c0 (raw 802f803d), prove q0 equals the 16 bytes at x19+0x270, and prove the store writes those bytes to x28+0xb0.
instrumentation.semanticCropUnionLink: Require each linked destination to be consumed later at prepare_layer +0x8570 (raw 88275729), retaining 48 bytes at x28+0xa0 and proving its +0xb0 crop equals the linked store.
instrumentation.semanticCropRootLink: Require the fourth invocation's caller x19 to equal the prospectively selected role base and its x5 to equal selected roleBase+aggregateOffset; it has no nested crop store link before the exact source marker.
